steps.title: Welcome to My Mod
steps.body: This tab is My Mod's page. Press **Click** to count a click: each one sends you a notification.

steps.title: Your greeting
steps.body: Pick the word the agent greets you with in this mod's settings.

steps.title: Ask the agent
steps.body: In a chat, ask *how many times was the my mod button clicked?* and the agent answers with this mod's tool. The Home page has a card with the count.
